Hiring: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition & HR Operations

**Company:** Pioneer Global Solutions  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** India  
**Department:** Human Resources

About Pioneer Global Solutions

Pioneer Global Solutions provides technology solutions and services to organisations across India, including software licensing, cloud solutions, business email, workforce management, remote desktop, data backup, cybersecurity, and AI.

We work with leading technology providers, including AWS, Yotta, Microsoft, Adobe, Autodesk, Google Workspace, greytHR, TSplus, eScan, Palo Alto Networks, and Central360.

Our approach goes beyond simply selling technology. We help customers identify the right solutions, implement them effectively, and provide ongoing support. From pre-sales consultation to post-sales service, our teams take ownership of the entire customer experience.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on **HR Manager with strong expertise in Recruitment and Talent Acquisition**to lead end-to-end hiring across our technical, sales, and corporate functions.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing the complete recruitment lifecycle independently, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing candidates to interview coordination, offer negotiation, and successful onboarding.

This role requires a target-oriented professional with excellent communication skills, strong follow-up discipline, and the ability to build a consistent pipeline of quality candidates while managing essential HR operations.

Key Responsibilities1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement gathering and job posting to candidate selection, offer release, and joining.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, and other relevant channels.
* Develop and maintain talent pipelines for current and upcoming hiring requirements.
* Recruit across technical, cloud, cybersecurity, IT sales, channel sales, and corporate functions.
* Screen and shortlist candidates based on role suitability, relevant experience, communication skills, compensation expectations, and notice period.
* Coordinate interviews and work closely with hiring managers to ensure timely recruitment closures.
* Manage candidate communication, interview follow-ups, offer negotiations, and joining formalities.
* Proactively address offer dropouts and improve candidate engagement and offer-to-joining conversion.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies for specialised and hard-to-fill positions.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring MIS.
* Track and report key recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, source effectiveness, interview-to-selection ratio, and offer-to-joining ratio.
* Support employer branding and initiatives to strengthen the company's presence in the talent market.

2. HR Operations & Employee Management

* Manage employee onboarding, documentation, attendance, leave records, and employee data.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, and other HR-related documentation.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, employee records, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Address employee queries and support employee engagement and basic employee relations.
* Maintain HR records and ensure compliance with applicable company policies and statutory requirements.
* Assist in developing, implementing, and improving HR policies, processes, and standard operating procedures.
* Support performance management, employee communication, and other core HR activities as required.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. An MBA or PGDM in HR will be an advantage.
* 3–5 years of relevant HR experience, with a strong focus on recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Proven experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment and delivering hiring targets.
* Prior experience hiring for IT, cloud, cybersecurity, technology sales, channel sales, or specialised business roles will be preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter or LinkedIn sourcing, Naukri, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.
* Excellent candidate sourcing, screening, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, recruitment trackers, HRMS platforms, or applicant tracking systems.
* A proactive, accountable, and results-driven approach, with a strong emphasis on follow-ups and timely closures.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise hiring requirements, and collaborate directly with management and business teams.

Why Join Pioneer Global Solutions?

* **Ownership and impact:** Take the lead in strengthening and building our recruitment function.
* **Direct management interaction:** Work closely with leadership and hiring managers on business-critical hiring requirements.
* **Technology exposure:** Recruit across dynamic technology domains, including cloud, cybersecurity, AI, software, and IT infrastructure.
* **Opportunity to build processes:** Help establish scalable recruitment practices, talent pipelines, and HR systems as the organisation grows.
* **A hands-on role:** Make a measurable contribution to team building, hiring efficiency, and organisational growth.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of hiring outcomes, follows through on commitments, builds strong candidate relationships, and understands that recruitment is not just about filling positions—it is about bringing the right people into the organisation at the right time.

If you are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys recruitment, thrives on targets, and is ready to take ownership of both talent acquisition and core HR operations, we would like to hear from you.

**Apply now to join Pioneer Global Solutions.**

Role positioning  
A senior OT cybersecurity profile combining industrial systems knowledge, cybersecurity expertise, client advisory capability and responsibility for delivery quality.  
  
Position Overview  
CGI is looking for an experienced OT Cybersecurity Expert to support clients in protecting industrial control environments and critical operational processes. The role spans cybersecurity assessment, architecture, remediation, incident response, governance and technical advisory activities.  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of cybersecurity, industrial engineering and operational constraints. They will translate cyber risks into actionable security measures while preserving safety, availability, continuity and business requirements.  
  
Core Scope  

* OT / ICS SCADA, DCS, PLCs, HMIs and industrial network environments

. Design secure architectures: define and review OT security patterns including segmentation, zones and conduits, network controls, access control and secure connectivity.

. Contribute to incident response: support investigation, containment, root cause analysis and post incident improvement activities affecting industrial environments.  
  
Responsibilities & Expected Contribution

title: Accounts Payable Manager - Finance
description:
About Signant Health
  
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Accounts Payable Manager will oversee and participate in all aspects of the accounts payable function across multiple legal entities, including processing vendor bills with accurate general ledger coding, approving employee expense reports, managing timely vendor payments, processing pass-through project expenses in accordance with customer contracts, and performing intercompany payable processing, while supervising the day-to-day work of a team of accounts payable specialists.
  
  
The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for deploying best practices to improve the quality of processes, maintaining electronic supporting records, ensuring compliance with Group accounting and purchasing processes, and delivering on vendor satisfaction and key reporting metrics.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function
  
  

* Directly supervise a team of accounts payable specialists, providing daily direction on delegated vendor assignments, managing and assigning incoming vendor bills and email distributions, training on systems and procedures, and evaluating job performance
* Maintain compliance, accuracy, and speed with strategic AP direction for efficiencies, synergies, and automation, ensuring strict adherence to the delegation of authority workflow and achievement of key performance indicators applicable to Accounts Payable
* Manage international, multicurrency, and intercompany vendors, recording vendor bills in the proper legal entities in accordance with intercompany posting policies set by Controllers
* Manage general ledger coding in accordance with ERP system and Group accounting policies for prepaids, fixed assets, accruals, and inventory and accrual management
* Oversee compliance of out-of-pocket/pass-through expense management and intercompany processes, including accurate and timely bill coding, reading contracts, obtaining project manager approvals, and retaining supporting files for multiple contracting entities
* Support Finance’s Accounts Receivable invoicing process related to customer contracts, and support the maintenance of systems that affect vendor bill coding, expense approval workflows, and process improvements
* Oversee expense report processing in multiple ERP systems in accordance with Group travel compliance policies, and support maintenance of related systems affecting expense report approval workflows and employee changes
* Support the purchase order process with procurement and supply chain teams, including purchase order workflow approvals and vendor bill matched receipts within an ERP system
* Propose payments in accordance with Group treasury policies, using banking software for multiple legal entities and currencies
* Maintain an organized electronic filing system for paperless and mailed vendor bills, purchase order approval support, and payment support
* Respond to vendor inquiries and internal requests in a timely manner, work collaboratively with internal teams across multiple entities, and track outstanding issues to resolution through effective communication and transparent supporting records, providing excellent customer service
* Maintain vendor management compliance and account relationships with the quality and ERP systems, treasury processes, and annual tax reporting (prepare 1099 information for year-end submission in accordance with IRS regulations, vendor set-up forms, and sales and use tax and VAT charges)
* Achieve departmental goals by developing and implementing process improvements that increase the efficiency and accuracy of invoice processing and payment distribution, including testing system upgrades, supporting system integrations, recommending and participating in automation initiatives, testing new processes, supporting global harmonization of practices, and documenting process narratives and workflows
* Build highly collaborative relationships with Finance General Ledger teams, Supply Chain/Procurement teams, and Client Delivery Project Managers to manage invoice approvals
* Build highly collaborative relationships with Finance IT to support ERP system processes and upgrades, and the integration of other systems that affect accounts payable processing and expense reports

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounts payable experience
* Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience managing accounts payable staff
* Ability to work with employees in remote locations and within a team environment as an individual contributor, build stable working relationships internally, and work extended hours as needed
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present information, respond to inquiries, and interact well with various levels of management internally and with external individuals at global locations
* Ability to read and understand contract language and engage in collaborative problem-solving that generates effective solutions consistent with the organization’s financial policies and procedures
* Effective time management skills to develop and direct realistic action plans for supervised teams, while creating a collaborative environment and ensuring internal stakeholder satisfaction
* Demonstrated judgment and outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Outlook; intermediate Excel skills, including pivot tables, H/V lookups, IF functions, and other advanced functions
* Experience working with electronic data, including accounting data within an ERP system; extracting and formatting ERP data exports; and maintaining organized paperless records, shared drives, and multiple file folders
* Confident and professionally poised, with a proven ability to work in a fast-paced team environment, meet deadlines, manage a high volume of transactions, and adapt to change with a seamless effect on the business

**Desirable:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, or a related discipline
* Accounts payable industry experience
* NetSuite ERP and/or Great Plains knowledge

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Role Purpose**

Haleon India's e-commerce business is a priority growth lever, and the Growth Analytics Manager is the person who turns our platform and market data into decisions. The role owns the business intelligence layer for DCommerce: platform-level dashboards, city-level reporting and daily market share tracking across marketplaces, quick commerce and e-pharma for all brands.

This is not a reporting/ data analytics role. The Growth Analytics Manager defines what we measure, makes sure the numbers can be trusted, and tells the business what to do next.

What Will The Person Own

* **Platform dashboards** : one consistent, decision-ready dashboard view per platform (offtake units, MRP value, NSV, share, availability, pricing), with brand, subcategory, SKU and NPI cuts built in.

* **City-level reporting** : city and cluster views of QCom and marketplace performance, so we can see where we are winning or losing, not just how we are doing nationally ; and actionability on pincodes/ RPI with strongly correlated inputs of promos and visibility

* **Daily market share view** : brand and subcategory share, built from platform & external analytics, tracked daily with clear trend and exception flags.

* **Metric definitions and data trust:** the single set of KPI definitions for DCom (including multipack and virtual combo treatment, and platform-specific quirks such as Amazon Core, Fresh and Now), and sign-off on every dashboard before it reaches leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Business Intelligence**

* Design, platform dashboards in Power BI (or equivalent) on top of the clean data layer provided by the Data Analyst; own the business logic, visuals and usability.

* Build the analytics reporting module within the existing DCom dashboard: platform views, NPI tracking shown separately from base business, multipack and combo views.

* Maintain a dashboard release and QC checklist so that numbers reconcile across offtake, MRP, NSV and platform-reported views.

2. **City-Level & Market Share Intelligence**

* Build city-level views of share, offtake, availability and pricing, using the city and pincode mapping on external data.

* Identify under-indexed cities and clusters by brand and platform, and convert them into specific actions (assortment, availability, visibility, activation).

* Track daily share movements at brand and subcategory level; flag material shifts, competitor moves and root causes within the same week.

3. **Insight to Action**

* Run weekly, monthly and quarterly performance reviews: what happened, why, and what we should do about it, with owners and follow-up on actions.

* Deliver brand and platform deep dives that lead to a decision (for example share erosion in a subcategory, OOS impact on a hero SKU, or a pricing gap versus competition).

* Partner with Digital Shelf to bring shopper research into the business narrative, so reviews combine the numbers with the shopper reasons behind them.

4. **Promo, Pricing & Growth Analytics**

* Own promo effectiveness analytics for e-commerce: uplift, ROI and cannibalisation by platform and brand.

* Manage the promo planning file and its platform-wise splits, so one master plan is adapted and shared correctly with each platform.

5. **Planning & Strategy Support**

* Support the annual and quarterly planning cycle with baselines, scenario models and growth lever sizing by brand, platform and city tier.

* Contribute to channel mix and competitor benchmarking so strategy is anchored on external facts as well as our own data.

**Skillsets Must have**

* 3-6 years in business analysis, e-commerce analytics, category management or BI, ideally in FMCG or consumer health.

* Strong Power BI (or Tableau) skills: you have built dashboards end to end, including data modelling and DAX or equivalent, not just consumed them.

* Advanced Excel (Power Query, complex modelling) and working SQL; Python is a plus.

* Sound understanding of Indian e-commerce and quick commerce: how offtake, share, availability and pricing behave across platforms.

* A structured storytelling habit: you move from what happened, to why, to what we should do, and you can defend the number in the room.

* Comfortable questioning data: you spot anomalies and push back on numbers that do not reconcile.

**Good to have**

* Experience with digital shelf or market share tools such as Gobblecube, NIQ, Profitero or similar.

* Exposure to promo analytics, pricing or RGM-style analysis.

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. * Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.

Job Description:
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Service Desk professional with strong operational and ITIL expertise to take ownership of the day-to-day operational governance of a multilingual Service Desk environment.  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that Service Desk operations are structured, measurable, governed and continuously improved. The individual will analyse operational performance, identify recurring issues and service gaps, drive corrective actions, ensure adherence to agreed processes and coordinate with L2/L3 teams to improve resolution outcomes.  
The role is not limited to managing people or monitoring queues. The successful candidate will act as a Service Desk subject-matter expert and operational governance owner, bringing structure, discipline and analytical insight into the operation.  
The role will work closely with the Service Delivery Manager, Service Desk Leads, L2/L3 resolver teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, workplace/EUS teams, vendors and client stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Service Desk Operational Governance  

* Own the day-to-day operational governance of the Service Desk.
* Establish and maintain operational routines covering:

o Daily operational review  
o SLA performance  
o Backlog  
o Aging tickets  
o Priority incidents  
o Reassignments  
o Escalations  
o Abandoned/unanswered calls  
o Ticket quality  
o Customer feedback  

* Ensure operational teams follow agreed processes, SOPs and ITIL practices.
* Identify deviations from the operating model and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate ownership and accountability across the Service Desk.
* Maintain operational readiness for changes, new services and project transitions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
2. Performance & Data Analysis  
This should be one of the core responsibilities of the role.  

* Analyse Service Desk performance trends and identify underlying causes.
* Monitor and interpret:

o SLA achievement  
o Response and resolution performance  
o Ticket volumes  
o Backlog  
o Aging  
o Reopen rates  
o First Contact Resolution  
o Escalation rates  
o Call abandonment  
o Customer satisfaction  
o Productivity  
o Quality scores  

* Identify trends rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Produce meaningful operational insights and recommendations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and translate them into improvement initiatives.
* Maintain dashboards and management reports.
* Prepare inputs for weekly/monthly service reviews.
* Highlight risks and emerging issues to the SDM before they become escalations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
3. Ticket Hygiene & Quality Management  

* Drive improvement in Service Desk ticket quality and documentation.
* Ensure tickets contain appropriate:

o Categorisation  
o Prioritisation  
o User/business impact  
o Troubleshooting performed  
o Worklogs  
o Resolution details  
o Knowledge references  
o Closure information  

* Perform regular ticket sampling and quality audits.
* Identify recurring quality issues by agent/team/process.
* Work with Team Leads to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure tickets are progressed appropriately and do not remain unnecessarily in queues.
* Identify tickets requiring escalation and ensure timely handover to L2/L3.
* Monitor tickets approaching SLA breach and ensure proactive intervention.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
4. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management  

* Provide operational oversight of Major/P1/P2 incidents from the Service Desk perspective.
* Ensure correct prioritisation and escalation based on business impact.
* Support Major Incident Management and ensure appropriate Service Desk participation.
* Identify recurring incidents and candidates for Problem Management.
* Analyse repeat incidents and identify opportunities for permanent resolution.
* Work with L2/L3 resolver groups to drive recurring-problem reduction.
* Track outstanding actions from major incidents and problem investigations.
* Ensure lessons learned are converted into process, knowledge or technical improvements.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
5. Cross-Functional Coordination  
Act as the operational bridge between Service Desk and resolver teams.  

* Coordinate with L2/L3 Infrastructure, Applications, EUS, IAM, Network, Cloud and other support teams.
* Identify bottlenecks in the incident/request resolution lifecycle.
* Challenge unnecessary ticket transfers and ownership gaps.
* Ensure clear escalation paths are followed.
* Drive resolution of aged or stuck tickets across resolver groups.
* Identify recurring dependency issues between Service Desk and other support towers.
* Work with application and infrastructure SMEs to improve knowledge available to the Service Desk.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
6. Process & Continual Service Improvement  

* Identify opportunities to streamline Service Desk processes.
* Review existing workflows and identify unnecessary manual steps.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives around:

o Incident management  
o Request fulfilment  
o Knowledge management  
o Escalation  
o Ticket routing  
o Categorisation  
o Automation  
o Self-service  
o Monitoring integration  

* Identify opportunities for automation and shift-left.
* Improve First Contact Resolution through better knowledge, tooling and training.
* Maintain and improve Service Desk SOPs and operational documentation.
* Support implementation of ITIL-aligned practices.
* Ensure improvements are measurable and demonstrate operational/business benefit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
7. Knowledge Management  

* Ensure knowledge articles are available and usable by Service Desk agents.
* Identify knowledge gaps from ticket trends and recurring incidents.
* Work with L2/L3 teams to convert technical resolutions into Service Desk knowledge.
* Review the quality and usefulness of existing knowledge articles.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge Management and shift-left practices.
* Identify opportunities for self-service and automation based on recurring requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
8. Team Coaching & Operational Enablement  
The role should not replace the Team Leads, but should provide SME-level direction and coaching.  

* Coach Team Leads and senior analysts on ITIL processes and operational practices.
* Support agents in improving troubleshooting and ticket-handling quality.
* Identify capability gaps based on operational data.
* Recommend targeted training and coaching.
* Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support onboarding of new Service Desk resources.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
9. Client & Stakeholder Support  
The person will have stakeholder interaction, but the SDM remains the primary client/account owner.  

* Provide operational inputs for client service reviews.
* Prepare factual analysis and recommendations for the SDM.
* Participate in operational governance meetings.
* Support service-related escalations.
* Provide timely updates on operational risks and improvement actions.
* Translate operational data into meaningful business-level insights.
* Support the SDM in preparing service improvement proposals and operational roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
10. Governance & Compliance  

* Ensure adherence to agreed governance frameworks and contractual processes.
* Maintain operational evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL, security and organisational processes.
* Track actions, risks, issues and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain Service Desk operational documentation and control mechanisms.
* Support internal and client audits where required.

Mandatory Skills:

**Role Purpose**

To support the Managing Director by ensuring that project-related tasks, departmental responsibilities, management instructions and pending requirements are followed up proactively and completed within the stipulated timelines.

The role primarily focuses on project and site coordination, interdepartmental follow-up, progress monitoring, MIS reporting, tracking pending requirements, and ensuring accountability among responsible teams. The EA must independently coordinate with departments and project teams, identify delays, obtain regular updates, and escalate unresolved matters to the MD.

Meeting arrangements, calendar management and routine administrative support are secondary responsibilities. Exceptional confidentiality, initiative, ownership and professional judgement are mandatory.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project and Site Follow-up**

* Follow up with site teams, Project Managers and project heads on tasks assigned by the MD and provide regular status updates.
* Follow up with responsible teams for timely submission of details regarding manpower, materials, machinery, billing, procurement and other site requirements.
* Identify pending requirements, resource shortages, delays and unresolved site issues and bring them to the attention of the concerned project head or MD.
* Ensure site teams submit daily and weekly project progress reports within the prescribed timelines.
* Consolidate site progress reports and present clear, concise updates for the MD’s review.
* Maintain an updated project action dashboard covering project progress, pending decisions, responsible persons, deadlines and site issues.
* Track commitments made by project teams and ensure pending actions are followed through until closure.
* Coordinate between Head Office and project sites to resolve information gaps and delays affecting project execution.

**2. Interdepartmental Coordination and Task Closure**

* Act as the coordination link between the MD and Projects, Planning, Billing, QA/QC, Procurement, Stores, Finance, Accounts, HR and Administration.
* Communicate the MD’s instructions clearly to the responsible departments, including deliverables, deadlines and expected outcomes.
* Follow up proactively with responsible employees and department heads to ensure assigned work is completed on time.
* Obtain regular updates on pending tasks without waiting for repeated instructions from the MD.
* Identify dependencies between departments and coordinate to resolve issues affecting project progress or business operations.
* Maintain a tracker of assigned tasks, responsible persons, target dates, current status and closure details.
* Escalate repeated delays, lack of response and unresolved issues to the MD with relevant facts and proposed next steps.

**3.** **QA/QC and RFI Tracking**

* Coordinate with the QA/QC team to track the status of open Requests for Information (RFIs) and follow up on pending closures.
* Maintain an updated RFI tracker with the reference number, project/site, responsible person, current status and target closure date.
* Follow up with QA/QC, consultants, site teams and other concerned stakeholders for pending responses and closures.
* Identify overdue and critical RFIs that may affect site execution or project progress.
* Escalate unresolved RFIs to the concerned project head or MD and include their status in management reports.

**4. MIS and Management Reporting**

* Collect departmental updates and prepare concise MIS reports, dashboards and briefing notes for the MD.
* Consolidate information relating to project progress, manpower, materials, machinery, billing, finance, approvals and site requirements.
* Ensure departments submit complete and accurate information within the required timelines.
* Follow up with concerned teams to obtain missing information, correct discrepancies and update pending items.
* Highlight significant delays, operational risks, pending decisions and matters requiring management intervention.
* Present information in a clear, structured and action-oriented format to support management decisions.

**5. Finance, Billing and Banking Coordination**

* Monitor the Pending Bill Tracker and Finance MIS Tracker to ensure the concerned teams regularly update and maintain them.
* Follow up with Finance, Accounts, Billing, Procurement and project teams regarding pending bills, supporting documents and approvals.
* Highlight overdue bills, missing documents, pending approvals and finance-related matters requiring the MD’s attention.
* Assist with banking operations and coordinate with bank representatives and the Finance team as required.
* Coordinate the preparation of cheques and supporting documents in accordance with company procedures and authorised approvals.
* Maintain organised records of banking correspondence and approved financial documents.
* Ensure financial transactions and banking instructions are processed only by authorised personnel under established approval procedures.

**6. Ownership, Initiative and Accountability**

* Take ownership of follow-up activities and ensure that the MD’s instructions are translated into clear actions.
* Anticipate pending requirements and proactively contact responsible teams before deadlines are missed.
* Ensure employees understand their responsibilities, deliverables and timelines.
* Maintain visibility of critical tasks and provide timely updates on completed, pending and overdue activities.
* Identify recurring delays and recommend practical ways to improve coordination and task completion.
* Use sound judgement when prioritising work and escalate sensitive, financial, contractual or management-level decisions for approval.
* Reduce the MD’s routine follow-up burden by ensuring that matters are monitored and progressed independently within delegated authority.

**7. Confidentiality, Integrity and Document Control**

* Maintain strict confidentiality of all company information, management discussions, financial details, banking matters, project records and business plans.
* Safeguard sensitive information relating to directors, management decisions, project costs, contracts, commercial terms, clients, vendors and employees.
* Share information only with authorised individuals on a need-to-know basis.
* Maintain organised records of approvals, project correspondence, reports and management documents.
* Ensure files, emails, presentations and records are stored systematically and can be retrieved when required.
* Never disclose, forward, copy or circulate confidential information to unauthorised persons.
* Report suspected information leakage, unauthorised access or confidentiality breaches promptly.
* Sign a Confidentiality Undertaking / Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), as required by the company.
* Continue to protect confidential company information after leaving the organisation, subject to applicable law and contractual obligations.

**8. Meeting Coordination and Action Tracking**

* Coordinate project review meetings and site visits, including schedules, required documents and follow-up actions.
* Prepare meeting agendas and ensure relevant reports and updates are available before discussions.
* Record accurate Minutes of Meeting (MoM), decisions, responsible persons and target completion dates.
* Maintain an action tracker for meeting decisions and follow up with action owners on pending tasks.
* Highlight overdue meeting actions and ensure unresolved matters are completed or escalated.

**9. MD Communication and Routine Coordination**

* Draft and organise emails, letters, presentations and other communications for the MD.
* File correspondence by date and maintain trackers for pending responses, approvals and action items.
* Prepare relevant documents and briefing notes when required by the MD.
* Manage daily follow-ups, schedules and routine coordination for the Managing Director as required.
* Provide calendar and appointment support when needed, ensuring these activities do not take priority over project follow-up, task closure and operational coordination.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong project and site follow-up skills.
* Excellent interdepartmental coordination and task-closure discipline.
* Ability to obtain updates from responsible teams and ensure accountability.
* Understanding of construction, railway, infrastructure or EPC project workflows.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, trackers, data consolidation and MIS reporting.
* Ability to prepare dashboards, management summaries and progress reports.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisation, prioritisation and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to identify delays, resource gaps and pending requirements.
* Professional maturity and confidence in coordinating with senior management, project heads and site teams.
* Exceptional confidentiality, integrity, discretion and trustworthiness.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative and escalate matters appropriately.

**Qualification & Experience**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering or an MBA in Operations, Project Management, General Management or a relevant specialisation.
* 6–8 years of relevant experience in project coordination, interdepartmental follow-up, management reporting or construction operations.
* Construction, railway, infrastructure or EPC industry experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating with project sites, Project Managers, department heads and senior management will be an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain trackers, follow up on pending work and drive assigned tasks to closure.
* Strong MS Excel and reporting skills are essential.
* Appropriate reference and background verification may be conducted where lawful and applicable.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely follow-up and closure of tasks assigned by the MD.
* Timely submission and consolidation of daily and weekly project progress reports.
* Accuracy and completeness of MIS reports and project dashboards.
* Timely tracking and escalation of pending site requirements and operational delays.
* Timely follow-up and closure of open RFIs.
* Regular maintenance and follow-up of Pending Bill and Finance MIS Trackers.
* Effective coordination between Head Office, project sites and internal departments.
* Reduction in repeated reminders required from the MD for routine follow-up.
* Timely identification and escalation of overdue tasks and unresolved issues.
* Accuracy, accessibility and confidentiality of company records.
* Effective meeting action tracking and follow-up on decisions.
* Demonstrated initiative, accountability, professional judgement and confidentiality.

**Candidate Profile — Recruitment Focus**

The ideal candidate is a proactive, organised and accountable professional with 6–8 years of relevant experience, preferably in the construction, railway, infrastructure or EPC industry.

The candidate must be capable of coordinating with multiple departments and project sites, obtaining regular updates, monitoring pending requirements, tracking deadlines and ensuring the MD’s instructions are completed without repeated intervention.

This is primarily a project follow-up, coordination and task-closure role, rather than a conventional secretarial position. The successful candidate must be confident in following up with responsible employees and department heads, identifying delays, escalating unresolved issues and maintaining clear management reports.

Exceptional confidentiality, integrity and discretion are mandatory because the role will have access to sensitive company-wide information, including management decisions, financial and banking matters, project details, commercial information, employee records and business plans.

The candidate must be trusted to handle confidential information responsibly, exercise sound judgement and work independently within delegated authority.

**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description: Operations Manager PCC (10+ Years Experience)**

**Position Title:** Operations Manager  
**Location:** Gurgaon (Building 8A)  
**Experience Required:** 10-15 Years in similar profile (operations, business management, department administration) in Engineering, Construction, Consulting organizations

**Qualification:** Graduate  
**Reporting To:** PCC Head

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day departmental operations.
* **Department’s Operational Finance:** Data Analysis, Management Reporting, and Supporting annual business planning, budgeting, utilization, KPIs, forecasting activities, etc.

* **Operational Project Manager for Company’s PM portal Workbench/ equivalent:** Project Setup, EAC update, Monthly Review, Risk Management, Raising invoices and Follow-up with client, Cash Flow Projections, etc.
* **Develop and Manage Project Costing** such as bid resource requirement, bid fee, internal fee approvals, etc. through company’s internal software/ app.
* **Resource Management** such as selection of resources for projects, coordination with talent acquisition team, managing onboarding/ release process, support/ guide resources in implementation of operational requirements.
* **Collaborate** with HR, TA, Finance, IT, Travel-desk, Admin, Sub-consultants, and Project teams to support operational requirements.
* **Operational processes** such as Timesheet Management, standardization across projects and teams, cross-departmental coordination, etc.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills**

* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Operational planning and execution
* Advanced MS Excel, PowerPoint, etc. and ability to learn new Softwares

  
**Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.
